page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred. Top to bottom: the author's name in large capitals, "V. CL.", the title, "LIBRI DUO RECOGNITI, & aucti." with a line break, the italic subtitle, "Editi à" and the editor's name with "U. J. D.", then a woodcut emblem with a motto in its border, then the place and printer, and the date "MDCXI" at the foot.

l.i: Methodicè digesti & exemplis sacris & profanis passim illustrati.

page.notes: The woodcut emblem shows a rocky mountain path with a bird perched on the summit and a traveller climbing; the border motto reads "EST VIA · INVIA · ... ILLA ... VITAN" (partly illegible in the scan). Decorative rules above and below the imprint. No page number, running head or signature. The motto text around the emblem is partly illegible and is not transcribed further.
